ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMERACCOUNTFINANCIALPRODUCT_TRU] AS
BEGIN
--GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct
AS(
    SELECT DISTINCT
    BTP.PORTFOLIO_NO AS CustomerAccountId
    ,BTS.INCEPTION_DATE AS PeriodStartDate
    ,BTP.PROD_CODE AS ProductId
    ,NULL AS IsoCurrencyCode
    ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS [InsertDttm]
    ,BTP.BNK_CODE  AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,'TRU' AS SourceSystemCode
    ,BTP.FILE_NAME AS FileName
    ,LEFT(RIGHT(BTP.FILE_NAME,12),8) AS FileDateKey
    FROM BUSC.TRU_PORTFOLIO BTP
    LEFT JOIN BUSC.TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION BTS ON BTP.Subscription_ID = BTS.Subscription_ID 
    WHERE BTP.isLatest = '1' AND BTS.isLatest = '1' 
  )


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct;

--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_SRC
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
     convert(char,IsoCurrencyCode)
     ,convert(varchar,ProductId)
    )) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_TGT
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
     convert(char,IsoCurrencyCode)
     ,convert(varchar,ProductId)
    )) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
  FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct
   WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'TRU' AND (PeriodEndDate = '9999-12-31' OR PeriodEndDate IS NULL) 
),

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_DELTA
AS(
SELECT
SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId, TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId, TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode, TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
,CASE
    WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'  
    WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
    ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS

FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_SRC SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_TGT TGT
ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL 
)
SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_DELTA;

--UPDATE RECORDS TO BNKM

UPDATE TGT
SET
PeriodEndDate =  DATEADD(day,-1,CONVERT(DATE,SRC.FileDateKey))
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId 
 AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId 
 AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode 
AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct SRC 
 ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
   AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
    AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndDate = '9999-12-31' OR  TGT.PeriodEndDate IS NULL





--INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct(
CustomerAccountId
,PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,ProductId
,IsoCurrencyCode
,UsageCategoryId
,CommitmentId
,SourceSystemCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
,FileName
,FileDateKey
)

SELECT
SRC.CustomerAccountId AS CustomerAccountId
,CASE WHEN DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT' THEN CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.PeriodStartDate)) 
      WHEN DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE' THEN CONVERT(DATE,SRC.FileDateKey) 
      END as PeriodStartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS PeriodEndDate
,SRC.ProductId AS ProductId
,NULL AS IsoCurrencyCode
,NULL AS UsageCategoryId
,NULL AS CommitmentId
,'TRU' AS SourceSystemCode
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,SRC.InsertDttm AS INSERTDTTM
,SRC.FileName
,SRC.FileDateKey
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId
  AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
   AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode
WHERE DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_DELTA;


END
GO
